caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular frame outlined in brown, containing four large, stylized leaf-like shapes that are arranged symmetrically: one in each corner, each pointing diagonally inward. These shapes are tan or beige with darker brown outlines and internal veins, and each has a central spiral or scroll motif in dark brown, with a touch of pink or purplish color accenting the curve. In the very center of the composition, there are two small red, rose-like flowers with green stems and leaves, facing opposite directions. The background of the rectangular area is a muted, light beige or gray color, and the entire drawing is surrounded by a wider, unadorned light tan margin.
title: Hooked Rug
